name: Amano Riara
source: A beautiful girl with a lighthearted personality. She is the most fashionable member of the group and is active in both dancing and modeling. She is a silly troublemaker who loves to play pranks. She is passionate about love and is eager to experience it, becoming single-minded focused on the protagonist when she fell in love with him.
translation: A beautiful girl with a lighthearted personality. She is the most fashionable member of the group and is active in both dancing and modeling.
